note: Village park on the east side of Hawkins, south of Highway 8, run by the Hawkins Lions Club: sites spread around the ball field and buildings, some with electric. It hosts motorsports events (mud bogs, truck and tractor pulls) in June and over Labor Day weekend's Harvest Festival. Across the highway, the 9-acre Hawkins Mill Pond has a fishing dock. --Claude
summary: Village parks page, OSM, Google and imagery read. 16 sites, some electric; $15 / $25 with electric; FCFS self-pay; outhouses, summer water, dump. Name per the village is 'Hawkins Lions Park'. Motorsports events at the park in June and on Labor Day. Note cleaned of the allstays aggregator mention. Not waterfront confirmed.
